summary: 9p connection cancellation writes p9_conn->err under req_lock while polling and worker paths read it locklessly to skip work after errors.

call_chain.evidence: KCSAN write side and patch hunk identify this function.
p9_poll_workfn iterates pending connections and calls p9_poll_mux.

interleaving: An error path calls p9_conn_cancel and stores a negative error in m->err under m->req_lock.
The global p9 poll worker concurrently calls p9_poll_mux and reads m->err without taking req_lock.
The fix marks the write and lockless reads with WRITE_ONCE/READ_ONCE.

ground_truth_access.required_ordering: Lock-protected writes to m->err must be paired with marked lockless reads in worker and request paths.

vulnerability_surface.why_relevant: m->err is the connection-wide error state used by cancellation, polling, read/write workers, and request submission to decide whether work may proceed.

aliases.name: m->err
aliases.evidence: Cancel path sets the connection error under req_lock.

aliases.name: m->err
aliases.evidence: Poll path reads the connection error before polling file descriptors.

aliases.name: ts->conn.err
aliases.evidence: Request path reaches the same p9_conn through client->trans.

thread_a.evidence: The cancel entry receives the connection pointer directly.

thread_b.evidence: p9_poll_workfn walks poll_pending_list and passes each conn to p9_poll_mux.

allocated_by: p9_fd_open initializes struct p9_conn embedded in struct p9_trans_fd
published_by: p9_poll_mux/poll pending list and client->trans references
freed_by: 9p transport close path after flushing workers

coverage.analysis_conclusion: The cancel, poll worker registration, poll function, and all patched m->err accesses are in trans_fd.c.

patch_hunks: fbc0283fbeae marks p9_conn->err reads with READ_ONCE and the cancel write with WRITE_ONCE/ASSERT_EXCLUSIVE_WRITER.
indirect_edges: p9_poll_workfn calls p9_poll_mux for connections on the pending list.
entry_discovery_log: trans_fd.ll defines p9_conn_cancel, p9_poll_workfn, and p9_poll_mux.
